title: New Descartes Spot™ Solution Helps Freight Forwarders Capture More Shipment Opportunities with Faster Quoting
summary: ATLANTA, Georgia and LONDON, U.K., November 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq:DSGX) (TSX:DSG), the global leader in uniting logistics-intensive businesses in commerce, announced the launch of Descartes Spot™, an innovative freight spot-rate solution designed to help freight forwarders improve quote win rates by returning 90% of customer requests for quotes within 30 seconds.
body_markdown:
**ATLANTA, Georgia and LONDON, U.K., November 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)** -- Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq:DSGX) (TSX:DSG), the global leader in uniting logistics-intensive businesses in commerce, announced the launch of Descartes Spot™, an innovative freight spot-rate solution designed to help freight forwarders improve quote win rates by returning 90% of customer requests for quotes within 30 seconds.


“Speed and transparency are real competitive differentiators in freight forwarding,” said Henning Voss, VP Product Management at Descartes. “Forwarding is a fast-moving, high-pressure business. Sales teams are under significant strain, and facing huge volumes of requests from customers that require manual, time-consuming work. In a competitive market, the first credible offer often wins. Descartes Spot turns this pressure into an advantage: for 90% of customer quote requests, a competitive offer can be sent back to the customer in 30 seconds or less. This means forwarders can respond while the opportunity is still live and put their energy where it counts: their market knowledge, their relationships, and the deal itself. It turns quoting into a strategic, revenue-generating advantage.”


Part of Descartes’[broker and forwarder enterprise systems](https://www.descartes.com/solutions/broker-and-forwarder-enterprise-systems) suite, the cloud-based Descartes Spot solution enables freight forwarders to generate accurate, customer-ready spot quotes in seconds rather than hours or days. Featuring a dynamic rating engine, the solution combines live, API-driven carrier rates, schedules, applicable fees, surcharges, transit times, quotation management, margin controls and market benchmarking in a single platform, helping teams respond quickly without sacrificing accuracy or profitability. Users simply enter a port pairing to instantly receive multiple transportation options complete with routes, schedules, transit times and fully calculated costs.


Using Descartes Spot, freight forwarders can:


- Win more shipment opportunities across 90% of quote requests by returning accurate quotes to customers in under 30 seconds
- Provide customers with multiple routing and departure options across trade lanes
- Save, manage, send and track quotes through integrated workflows
- Eliminate manual rate gathering, spreadsheet-based quoting and carrier website searches
- Empower business development teams to generate quotes independently without operational bottlenecks
- Protect margins with configurable pricing controls and Xeneta-powered market benchmarking


“Leading freight forwarders are increasingly operating as growth-focused sales organizations, where responsiveness and customer experience play a larger role in winning business,” added Ken Wood, EVP Product Management at Descartes. “By removing the delays associated with manual spot quoting, Descartes Spot helps forwarders respond to more opportunities, improve win rates and drive profitable growth.”


Learn more about the[Descartes Spot](https://www.descartes.com/resources/knowledge-center/freight-spot-rate-software) solution for freight forwarders.


**About Descartes**


Descartes powers more responsive, efficient, secure and sustainable international and domestic supply chains by uniting logistics-intensive businesses on its Global Logistics Network (GLN). Shippers, carriers, and logistics service providers connect and collaborate on the GLN leveraging technology, data and AI to manage last mile deliveries, domestic and international shipments, transportation rating and payment, global trade research, customs compliance and a variety of regulatory processes.
